sources.title: Four-Periodic Counterexamples to Two Elliptic Billiard Invariants
sources.author: Alper Ferudun
sources.scope: All four PDF pages read; pages 2 and 3 visually checked. Equations compared algebraically with the original PR. Full companion main.tex and named narrative/source-audit ZIP members read, but no third-party checker executed.
sources.target_pages: Lemma 1 p2; Theorem 2 and literal k107 witness p3; attribution p4
sources.assessment: Exact contemporary same-target overlap, later than provider PR creation/update dates. Includes sharper full-family formula and ranges; no independence or exclusive-priority inference.

sources.title: Exploring self-intersected N-periodics in the elliptic billiard

sources.target_pages: Table 1 p55; Props4.7,4.9 p58; counterexamples4.10 p58 and4.19 p62; Section5 p64; AppendixB.2/B.3 pp68–69
sources.assessment: General four-period vertices, caustic, area extrema and AA'=8a^2 b^2 pre-exist. Counterexamples concern k804. No explicit k107 correction or its area/half-angle combination located.

sources.title: The geometry of billiards in ellipses and their Poncelet grids
